summary: Implemented the terminal window title control in the repository without running tests or committing. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the OSC 0 formatting entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds set_window_title, gated only on is_terminal, returning True when written and False otherwise, with the Google-style docstring; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds one elif branch that calls term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gains an Added heading under Unreleased with a bullet linking PR 2200; tests added to tests/test_console.py, tests/test_control.py, and tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Tests and mypy were not run, per instructions; types and imports were checked by reading only.
